title: Language Model Client Integrations
summary: This module provides core abstractions for interacting with various language models, including LiteLLM-based clients for different completion types, and integrations for managing local and cloud-based (Databricks, OpenAI) finetuning and serving.

nodes.label: Base Language Model Interface
nodes.title: BaseLM
nodes.description: Defines the fundamental contract for all language models in DSPy, including request handling, response processing, and history management.

nodes.label: Synchronous Chat Completion
nodes.title: litellm_completion
nodes.description: Facilitates synchronous chat completion requests to various LLMs via LiteLLM, handling caching and retries.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Chat Completion
nodes.title: alitellm_completion
nodes.description: Enables asynchronous chat completion requests to various LLMs via LiteLLM, supporting non-blocking operations.

nodes.label: Synchronous Responses Completion
nodes.title: litellm_responses_completion
nodes.description: Manages synchronous requests to LiteLLM's 'responses' API, converting chat requests to the appropriate format.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Responses Completion
nodes.title: alitellm_responses_completion
nodes.description: Handles asynchronous requests to LiteLLM's 'responses' API, ensuring non-blocking interaction with LLMs.

nodes.label: Synchronous Text Completion
nodes.title: litellm_text_completion
nodes.description: Processes synchronous text completion requests through LiteLLM, including prompt construction and API key management.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Text Completion
nodes.title: alitellm_text_completion
nodes.description: Manages asynchronous text completion requests via LiteLLM, handling prompt formatting and API interactions.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Stream Handler
nodes.title: async_stream_completion
nodes.description: An internal utility for managing and processing asynchronous streaming responses from language models.

nodes.label: Local LLM Server & Finetuning
nodes.title: LocalProvider
nodes.description: Manages the lifecycle of local SGLang servers for LLMs and orchestrates local finetuning processes.

nodes.label: Local Finetuning Tokenizer
nodes.title: tokenize_function
nodes.description: Provides tokenization logic specifically for preparing data for local finetuning of language models.

nodes.label: Databricks LLM Integration
nodes.title: DatabricksProvider
nodes.description: Connects DSPy with Databricks for deploying finetuned models as serving endpoints and managing finetuning jobs.

nodes.label: Databricks Finetuning Job Tracker
nodes.title: TrainingJobDatabricks
nodes.description: Represents and tracks the status and details of a finetuning job executed on the Databricks platform.

nodes.label: OpenAI Finetuning Job Tracker
nodes.title: TrainingJobOpenAI
nodes.description: Manages the state and operations, including cancellation, for finetuning jobs submitted to OpenAI.

nodes.label: LiteLLM API
nodes.title: LiteLLM API
nodes.description: External API for interacting with various language models through the LiteLLM library.

nodes.label: SGLang Local Server
nodes.title: SGLang Local Server
nodes.description: A local server for serving language models, often used for development and testing.

nodes.label: Databricks API
nodes.title: Databricks API
nodes.description: The external API for Databricks services, including model serving and finetuning.

nodes.label: OpenAI API
nodes.title: OpenAI API
nodes.description: The external API for OpenAI services, including finetuning jobs.

groups.title: OpenAI Finetuning Management
